data.title: Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina
data.about:
Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina, a distinguished development by IHG Hotels & Resorts and Select Group, sets a new standard for luxury living. Showcasing expert craftsmanship and cutting-edge design, this unique destination offers an unmatched lifestyle at one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations.

The residences boast a variety of layouts including 2, 3, and 4-bedroom units, as well as exclusive 4-bedroom half-floor penthouses, 4-bedroom duplex sky mansions, and expansive 5-bedroom triplex sky mansions. 

Each floor plan at Six Senses Place is meticulously designed to maximize space and comfort. Towering 122 stories, Six Senses Dubai Marina promises breathtaking views and an extraordinary living experience in the bustling heart of the city. With the anticipated handover of Six Senses, these residences are a prime opportunity for discerning buyers.

characteristics_module.title: First Ever Standalone Branded Residences
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• Extensive Amenities: Spread across four levels, covering 61,250 sq. ft.
  • Holistic Wellbeing: Focus on longevity, wellness, and human connection.
  • Exclusive Community: Prioritizes comfort, convenience, and well-being.
  • Owner Benefits: Dedicated residence general manager, 24/7 concierge, valet, residential portal, and more.
  • Progressive Design: Iconic structure reaching unprecedented heights, seamlessly integrating into Dubai Marina's dynamic landscape.
  • Exquisite Residences: 251 units including deluxe residences, penthouses, and Sky Mansions.
  • Sustainable Design: Meticulously designed for sustainability, well-being, and contentment.
  • Panoramic Views: Sweeping vistas of Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, Blue Waters, and more.

location_tile.title: Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina: An Address Unlike Any Other
location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Nestled within Dubai Marina Six Senses Residences situates residents right at the epicenter of the city's coveted Dubai Marina district, the ultimate destination for those in pursuit of a dynamic yet harmonious lifestyle.

Six Senses at Dubai Marina offers an authentic cosmopolitan experience, perfectly blending luxury living with urban vibrancy. From indulging in opulent shopping at Dubai Marina Mall to embarking on sailing adventures from the esteemed yacht club, or even admiring the breathtaking architectural wonders, Dubai Marina captivates with its fusion of elegance, flair, and coastal allure.

  • 05 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 05 Minutes to Dubai Harbour Beachfront
  • 10 Minutes to JBR The Beach
  • 10 Minutes to Mall of The Emirates
  • 20 Minutes to Expo City
